workplace_task.fil: Sa loob ng 2–4 linggo, magsanay ng usapan at handover kasama ang midwife gamit ang kathang-isip na kaso.
workplace_task.en: Within 2–4 weeks, practise a conversation and handover with the midwife using a fictional case.

supervision.fil: Obserbahan gamit ang parehong lesson indicator; magbigay ng feedback at pagkakataong umulit.
supervision.en: Observe using the same lesson indicator; provide feedback and a retry.

delivery: content specification only; no reminders scheduled

check.prompt_fil: Gusto ni Rosa na bumalik si Amina sa hapon. Ano ang pinakamainam na plano?
check.prompt_en: Rosa wants Amina to return in the afternoon. Which plan fits?

options.fil: Kumpirmahin ang oras at babalikang alalahanin.
options.en: Confirm the time and concern to revisit.

options.fil: Tapusin ang tanong sa harap ng kapitbahay.
options.en: Finish the questions in front of the neighbors.

options.fil: Itala na tumanggi sa lahat ng pagbisita.
options.en: Record that she refused all visits.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Sinusunod nito ang napagkasunduan at may malinaw na susunod na hakbang. 2: Hindi nito tinutugunan ang alalahanin sa pribadong usapan. 3: Hindi ito ang sinabi ni Rosa; ibang oras ang hiniling niya.
check.feedback_en: 1: This respects the agreement and gives a clear next step. 2: This does not address the privacy concern. 3: That is not what Rosa said; she requested another time.

check.prompt_fil: Sinabi ni Liza na hindi niya alam kung sino ang kakausapin. Ano ang susunod na sasabihin ni Jun?
check.prompt_en: Liza says she does not know whom to approach. What should Jun say next?

options.fil: “Ayaw po ba ninyong bumalik dahil matagal?”
options.en: “Do you refuse to return because it takes too long?”

options.fil: “Hindi pa malinaw ang contact. Tama po ba?”
options.en: “The contact is still unclear. Is that right?”

options.fil: “Sigurado po akong matatapos ito ngayong araw.”
options.en: “I am sure this will be finished today.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nagdadagdag ito ng motibo na hindi sinabi ni Liza. 2: Ibinubuod nito ang narinig at humihingi ng pagwawasto. 3: Nangangako ito ng resulta bago makumpirma ang magagawa ng staff.
check.feedback_en: 1: This adds a motive Liza did not state. 2: This summarizes what was heard and invites correction. 3: This promises an outcome before staff availability is confirmed.

check.prompt_fil: Pumayag si Ben na magtanong muna si Salma. Aling pagtatapos ang pinakamalinaw?
check.prompt_en: Ben agrees that Salma will first ask. Which closing is clearest?

options.fil: “Sige po, hintayin na lang natin ang mangyayari.”
options.en: “All right, let us wait and see what happens.”

options.fil: “Pumunta na po kayo bukas; bahala na ang staff.”
options.en: “Just go tomorrow; staff will deal with it.”

options.fil: “Magtatanong ako at tatawag bukas ng alas-dos.”
options.en: “I will ask and call tomorrow at two.”

check.feedback_fil: 1: Walang nakatalagang kilos o oras ng pagbalita. 2: Ginagawa nitong appointment ang hindi pa kumpirmadong usapan. 3: May hakbang, responsable at oras na puwedeng kumpirmahin kay Ben.
check.feedback_en: 1: No action or update time is assigned. 2: This turns an unconfirmed discussion into an appointment. 3: This has an action, owner and time to confirm with Ben.

check.prompt_fil: Naipasa na ni Datu ang handover. Ano ang makabuluhang pagninilay?
check.prompt_en: Datu has handed over the concern. Which reflection is useful?

options.fil: Mag-alok ng pribadong lugar nang mas maaga sa susunod.
options.en: Offer a private place earlier next time.

options.fil: Iwasan na ang lahat ng residenteng maraming tanong.
options.en: Avoid all residents who ask many questions.

options.fil: Sabihing maayos ang lahat kahit hindi nakinig nang buo.
options.en: Say everything went well despite not fully listening.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tiyak itong pagbabago na maaari niyang subukan at suriin. 2: Hindi nito pinabubuti ang sariling pakikitungo o access sa serbisyo. 3: Hindi nito sinusuri ang aktuwal na nangyari o kailangang baguhin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a specific change he can try and review. 2: This does not improve his response or access to service. 3: This does not examine what happened or what needs to change.
